items.headline: Eagles' Saquon Barkley says hamstring 'great' in return, not sweating back issue
items.description: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley said his "hamstring came out great" and doesn't believe his back issue will keep him out after a gutsy and highly efficient performance in a loss to the Cowboys on Monday night.

items.headline: Dak Prescott throws 3 TD passes, Javonte Williams runs for 155 yards as Cowboys beat Eagles 38-21
items.description: — Tanner McKee and the Philadelphia Eagles still had a potential victory within their grasp in the fourth quarter when the career backup threw a pass into the outstretched hands of DeMarvion Overshown.

items.headline: Cowboys handle Eagles on Javonte Williams' career night
items.description: Williams rushed for a career-high 155 yards and added a touchdown for Dallas.
